reference.name: Products Title column header does not open query actions
reference.summary: Products Title column header does not open query actions.
reference.expected: Clicking the Title header should open the column action menu, including sorting and filtering, as adjacent Products columns do.
reference.actual: Clicking either the Title columnheader or its parent button opens no menu or dialog. Category immediately beside it opens the normal menu with sorting, Filter by this column, Distribution, and Distinct values. The Title header remains inert with all default columns or with only Title, Title+Price, or Title+Price+ID selected.
reproSteps: Sign in and choose New > Question > Sample Database > Products.
Click Visualize, leaving the default selected columns.
Click the Title column header. Observe that nothing opens.
Click the adjacent Category column header. Observe the normal column actions menu, confirming header actions are available in this question.
reference.reason: Cannot reproduce on human review: the report clicked the column area, not the header button, which opens the menu.
